wins: Boros cavalry: cheap Knights and Humans attack in waves, Théoden hands out double strike, and Éomer turns a lost legend into an extra combat.
plan: Ranger’s Firebrand clears a blocker. East-Mark Cavalier, Westfold Rider and Merry come down early.
Théoden: every Human you cast after him gives a creature double strike that turn. Flowering of the White Tree pumps the team (+2/+1 for legends).
Éowyn exiles their biggest creature with haste; Éomer (haste) untaps your team for a second combat whenever another attacking legend dies. Rally at the Hornburg adds hasty Soldiers.
keys: Double strike on demand: cast a Human precombat and pick your biggest attacker.
Haste plus exile their best bigger creature, and protection for your legends.
Extra combat step when an attacking legend dies. Attack aggressively with legends.
Counters free spells, and sacrifices to make your team indestructible.
tips: Merry draws a card when he attacks alongside another legend.
Ranger’s Firebrand and Boromir make "the Ring tempt you": pick a legend as Ring-bearer; it becomes legendary and can’t be blocked by bigger creatures.
Westfold Rider sacrifices to destroy an artifact or enchantment.
Minas Tirith draws a card after you attack with two or more creatures.
Gandalf the White has flash and lets you flash in legends: hold him for the opponent’s end step.
mulligan: Keep 2–4 lands with two or more 2-drops.
